simple.title: Put a local temperature change in global context
simple.question: What do a modeled point and the global index each show over the same years?
simple.meaning: Both slopes describe historical fitted changes at different spatial and observational supports. This is NOT a formal local-vs-global significance test.
simple.nextStep: Check nearby station observations, local land use and the GISTEMP source methodology before drawing adaptation or attribution conclusions.

trend.note: Exploratory classical OLS t-inference; serial correlation and multiple testing can invalidate p-values.

advanced.caveat: Seasonal 2001–2020 rebasing removes separately estimated monthly normal offsets. GISTEMP and POWER have different methodologies, geography and data generation. The derived annual slope comparison is descriptive, not a paired causal or formal statistical difference, and GISTEMP may revise historic records.
